review_basis: Unboxed source video at the exact detector snapshot and 12 source frames before and after; broad near-side phase only, not exact touch or rally boundary

phase_definitions.near_defense: The far side appears to control or attack the ball while the near side prepares or responds defensively
phase_definitions.near_offense: The near side appears to control or attack the ball while the far side defends or blocks
phase_definitions.serve_or_reset: A player appears to prepare a serve or players appear to reset; no active exchange can be confirmed

rows.note: Near blue side is in a receiving shape below far white net action.
Far white side attacks across the net; near blue side reacts.
Far white net action and near blue defensive formation persist through the three frames.
Near blue player moves toward the net as teammates arrange for an attack.
Both teams are nearly stationary and the far white player is beyond the end line; an active exchange is not visible.
Far white player is down behind the court while near blue side occupies the attacking half.
Far blue attacker approaches the net while near white side sets its defense.
Far blue player dives in response to the near white front-row action.
Near white server is at or behind the end line during the serve motion; this is not a comparable open-play frame.
Far blue side controls the ball close to the net and near white side is in receiving shape.
Near white front-row player attacks against far blue blockers.
Near white side sets the ball while far blue side forms a block.
Near blue attacker approaches a far white block.
Far white side is playing at the net and near blue team holds a defensive shape.
Far white player attacks near the net against near blue defenders.
Far white defender dives while near blue side holds a front-court attacking shape.
Far white side passes or sets near the net; near blue side faces it in defensive shape.
